# Paper alignment fixtures

Frozen research-repo outputs (IJAMT latest) for the app's forward-alignment
and round-trip acceptance suites. Generated by copy/extract from the research
repo at fixture-creation time; tests never reference the research repo at
runtime. Regenerate only from research; never edit by hand.

| Fixture | Source (research repo) | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `plate06_a_standard.csv` | `data/results/PLATE-06-H2C-paper-matrix/runs/A-standard/per_cell_de.csv` | PLATE-06-H2C-A 780 cells (30x26): code + model prediction (paper hybrid_per_color_k_td1s_gamma, fitted A-standard params, layer height 0.32 mm) |
| `randmix5_a_beige_safe.csv` | `data/results/RANDMIX5-H2C-fit/runs/A-beige-safe/per_cell_de.csv` | RANDMIX5-H2C-A 780 cells: code + model prediction (fitted beige-safe params, layer height 0.32 mm) |
| `randmix5_materials.json` | `runs/A-beige-safe/fitted_params.json` + paper Table 4 | The five arbitrary filaments as app ColorConfig values: td = ln(10) * (s_td * td_stair^gamma_td) / alpha_s (exact fold of the fitted transmission), k = fitted k |
| `clear_cmyg_p07_def.csv` | engine `beer_lambert_td_rgb` over `calibration/plates/clear_cmyg/..._code.csv` with P07-def staircase td_rgb (crossval_report.json) | CMYG plate print 1 (default): 256 cells (16x16), layer height 0.84 mm, full-precision engine predictions |
| `clear_cmyw_p08_kxa.csv` | engine `beer_lambert_td_rgb` over `calibration/plates/clear_cmyw/..._code.csv` with P08-kxa staircase td_rgb | PLATE-08-KX-A: 256 cells (16x16), layer height 0.84 mm |

The clear prediction CSVs are engine outputs at full float precision (6 dp);
the plate-06/randmix5 CSVs inherit the research reports' 2-dp rounding.
